blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A leader is a person who guides a team. A good leader listens, explains, and helps. A leader does not need to shout.

A real leader brings calm and direction. When the team is worried, the leader stays calm and shows the way.

Leadership is not only for the boss. Every person can be a leader in their own work — when they help, when they plan, when they teach others.

items.q: What does a good leader do?
items.why: "A good leader listens, explains, and helps."

items.q: What does a real leader bring to the team?
items.why: "A real leader brings calm and direction."

items.q: According to the text, who can be a leader?
options: Every person in their own work
items.why: "Every person can be a leader in their own work."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: Leadership is not only for the boss
A good leader must shout to be strong
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "A leader does not need to shout", então o autor discordaria dessa ideia.

items.q: "A leader is a person who guides a team" suggests that a leader…
items.why: Inferência: guiar (to guide) significa mostrar o caminho ao time.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James no workshop de liderança. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, everyone. Today I want to talk about a simple question. What is the difference between a boss and a leader?

A boss gives orders. A boss says, "Do this now." People do the work because they are afraid. But a leader is different. A leader explains the goal. A leader listens first, and then speaks. People follow a leader because they trust him.

When I was young, I had a boss who liked to shout. The team was quiet and scared. Nobody wanted to help. Then I had a leader who stayed calm. She always asked, "What do you think?" The team was happy, and we did great work together.

So my advice today is simple. You should lead by example. You should respect your team. And you should stay calm in hard moments. Remember, leadership is not about power. It is about people. Thank you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What question does James want to talk about?
options: The difference between a boss and a leader
items.why: "What is the difference between a boss and a leader?"

items.q: According to James, why do people follow a leader?
items.why: "People follow a leader because they trust him."

items.q: What did James's calm leader always ask?
items.why: "She always asked, 'What do you think?'"

items.q: Why was the team with the shouting boss quiet and scared?
items.why: Inferência: o chefe gritava, então o time ficava com medo e ninguém queria ajudar.

items.q: What does James mean when he says "leadership is about people"?
options: A leader should hire more people
A leader should work without people
A leader should care about the team, not power
A leader should count the people
items.why: Inferência: ele contrasta poder com pessoas — liderar é cuidar do time.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "A good manager will guide the new worker on the first day." To guide means to…
items.why: To guide = guiar, mostrar o caminho e ajudar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A leader should ___ to the team before making a decision."
items.why: To listen = ouvir; o líder ouve o time antes de decidir.

items.q: "The team was nervous, but the leader stayed calm." Calm means…
items.why: Calm = calmo, tranquilo e relaxado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A good leader will ___ the goal clearly, so everyone understands."
items.why: To explain = explicar; o líder explica o objetivo com clareza.

items.q: "Good leaders earn the respect of their team." Respect means…
options: a good feeling of value for someone
items.why: Respect = respeito, o valor e a consideração que o time sente pela pessoa.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem quando falamos de liderança. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "A good leader should lead by example." This means to…
options: do the right thing so others can copy it
items.why: Lead by example = liderar pelo exemplo, fazer para os outros seguirem.

items.q: "When a colleague is sick, a good leader will step up and help." To step up means to…
items.why: Step up = assumir mais responsabilidade, dar um passo à frente.

items.q: "I will back you up in the meeting." This means I will…
items.why: Back (someone) up = apoiar, dar suporte à pessoa.

items.q: "The young workers look up to her." This means they…
items.why: Look up to = admirar, respeitar alguém como referência.

items.q: "A real leader will stand up for the team." This means to…
items.why: Stand up for = defender, ficar do lado de alguém.
